title: Yellow Mech Punk Boy
description: A young male character with spiky blonde hair is shown in three sequential action poses against a dark background. He wears a bulky black and yellow armored suit with mechanical details, large gloves, and knee pads, with yellow sparks and liquid effects exploding from his head and body.
